business_problem: Huaxiyun and its Xinjiang media customers needed a faster, more reliable way to review huge volumes of broadcast and video content because manual review was expensive, slow, and prone to missing risky or noncompliant material.
solution_summary: Huaxiyun introduced Baidu AI Cloud's VCR media-content-review capability into the Shiliu Media Cloud used for Xinjiang radio and television operations. The system applies deep-learning-based content moderation to images and video so it can detect politically sensitive material, pornography, violence, terrorism, commercial spam, and other problem categories that human reviewers may miss at scale. It also evaluates visual quality attributes such as image clarity and aesthetics, allowing the media platform to classify content by service level instead of only blocking risk. Architecturally, the moderation engine is combined with Huaxiyun's broader cloud-media environment, which is built on distributed cloud-computing and big-data capabilities to support media services across Xinjiang.

solution_components.name: VCR
solution_components.role: Provides the deep-learning moderation engine for image and video review inside the media cloud.

solution_components.name: Content Review Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the service layer that manages media-review workflows and risk filtering.

solution_components.name: Offline Face Recognition SDK
solution_components.role: Adds supporting media-recognition capability for richer review and analysis scenarios.

data_flow: Video and image content enters the Shiliu Media Cloud, where VCR analyzes frames for risky categories and image-quality attributes. Review results flow back into the content-review platform so broadcasters can intercept unsafe material quickly and move approved content through the publishing pipeline faster.
business_outcome: Huaxiyun improved content-review speed and safety for Xinjiang media workflows, reduced manual moderation effort, and created a cloud-based moderation model that can scale across many broadcast channels.
metrics: The deployment achieved zero missed detections.
The system covers 100+ channels across Xinjiang.
architecture_clues: The review engine detects more than 20 categories of risk content
The solution is delivered inside a distributed media-cloud architecture serving the full Xinjiang region
The platform combines content-risk detection with image-quality evaluation
